title: 第2618章 乾坤鼎的变化第2617章 会飞的蝎子王
slug: 我装了三年废物出手人间无敌
content_zh:
随着周围的星力不断涌入体内，楚云能够清楚地感觉到，丹田里面的乾坤鼎正在快速吸收这些星力。
而在吸收掉大量星力后，乾坤鼎开始以肉眼可见的速度变大。
半炷香后。
巨大蝎王和周围那些黑色蝎子体内的星力，全部被楚云吸收干净。
失去星力支撑后，巨大蝎王的尸体开始快速干瘪，最后只剩下一副漆黑的甲壳。
楚云缓缓睁开眼睛。
他本以为吸收这么多星力，修为能够一举进入星主境。
然而当他检查修为后，却发现修为依然停留在星鼎境。
虽然距离星主境已经很近，但是始终没有突破。
见到这一幕，楚云皱起眉头。
“吸收了这么多星力，居然只是让乾坤鼎大了一圈。”
这只巨大蝎王体内蕴含的星力，堪比数名星主境修士。
再加上周围数十只黑色蝎子体内的星力，就算不能让他一举进入星主境，至少也应该让他的修为出现明显提升。
可现在他的修为几乎没有变化。
就在楚云疑惑时，两道破空声突然响起。
只见姬沐雪和梦青璃从远处掠来，很快便落在他的身前。
姬沐雪看了一眼地上的巨大蝎王尸体，又将目光投向楚云。
当看见楚云脸色有些不好看后，她疑惑道：“怎么了，殿主？”
楚云缓缓站起身。
“我本以为吸收这些蝎子体内的星力，能让我进入星主境。”

“没想到修为没有提升多少，只是让乾坤鼎大了一圈。”
姬沐雪闻言，先是一怔，随即开口安慰道：“你的星鼎跟别人不一样。”
“虽然它会让你晚点进入星主境，但是你想想，一旦你的乾坤鼎自成一方天地，那么以后不仅可以保住你的命，还能保住大家的命。”
“相比之下，晚一点进入星主境，其实也没有什么。”
梦青璃轻轻点头。
“不错。”
“乾坤鼎可不是普通星鼎，很多修士想凝聚都凝聚不出来。”
“而且你修炼的星法十分特殊，吸收星力的速度远超其他人。”
“所以进入星主境，对你来说只是时间问题。”
听到两人如此一说，楚云长出一口气。
他仔细想了想，感觉两人说得有道理。
乾坤鼎每一次发生变化，里面的空间都会随之扩大。
如果有一天，乾坤鼎里面真的能够自成一方天地，那么作用将会远超普通星鼎。
想到这里，楚云心中的郁闷消散不少。
姬沐雪看向巨大裂缝旁边的半块石碑，问道：“殿主，石碑上记载的文字，是不是混元界狱阵的下半部分？”
content_en:
As the surrounding star power continued to pour into his body, Chu Yun could clearly feel that the Qiankun Cauldron in his dantian was rapidly absorbing these star powers.
After absorbing a large amount of star power, the Qiankun Cauldron began to grow in size at a speed visible to the naked eye.
After half a stick of incense.
All the star power in the giant scorpion king and the surrounding black scorpions were absorbed by Chu Yun.
After losing the support of star power, the giant scorpion king's body began to wither quickly, and finally only a black carapace remained.
Chu Yun slowly opened his eyes.
He originally thought that by absorbing so much star power, he would be able to enter the Star Lord realm in one fell swoop.
However, when he checked his cultivation, he found that his cultivation was still at the Star Cauldron realm.
Although it is very close to the Star Lord Realm, there has never been a breakthrough.
Seeing this scene, Chu Yun frowned.
"Absorbing so much star power actually only made the Qiankun Cauldron a little bigger."
The star power contained in this giant scorpion king is comparable to several star master realm monks.
Coupled with the star power in the dozens of black scorpions around him, even if he cannot enter the Star Lord realm in one fell swoop, it should at least make his cultivation level significantly improved.
But now his cultivation level has almost remained unchanged.
Just when Chu Yun was confused, two sounds of breaking through the air suddenly sounded.
Ji Muxue and Meng Qingli were seen flying from a distance, and soon landed in front of him.
Ji Muxue glanced at the huge Scorpion King corpse on the ground, and then turned her gaze to Chu Yun.
When she saw that Chu Yun's face looked a little ugly, she asked doubtfully: "What's wrong, Palace Master?"
Chu Yun slowly stood up.
"I thought that absorbing the star power in these scorpions would allow me to enter the Star Lord realm."
"I didn't expect that the cultivation level didn't improve much. It just made the Qiankun Cauldron a little bigger."
When Ji Muxue heard this, she was startled for a moment, and then said to comfort her: "Your Star Cauldron is different from others."
"Although it will make you enter the Star Lord realm later, think about it. Once your Qiankun Cauldron becomes its own world, it will not only save your life, but also everyone's lives."
"In comparison, entering the Star Lord realm later is actually nothing."
Meng Qingli nodded slightly.
"Not bad."
"The Qiankun Cauldron is not an ordinary star cauldron. Many monks cannot condense it even if they want to."
"And the star method you practice is very special, and you can absorb star power much faster than others."
"So it is only a matter of time for you to enter the Star Lord realm."
Hearing what the two said, Chu Yun let out a sigh of relief.
He thought about it carefully and felt that what the two people said made sense.
Every time the Qiankun Cauldron changes, the space inside will expand accordingly.
If one day, the Qiankun Cauldron can truly form its own world, its effect will be far greater than that of an ordinary Star Cauldron.
Thinking of this, Chu Yun's depression dissipated a lot.
Ji Muxue looked at half of the stone tablet next to the huge crack and asked: "Palace Master, are the words recorded on the stone tablet the lower part of the Hunyuan Realm Prison Formation?"
